description:
Update the HIPAA communication preferences for patient 'Maria Rodriguez'. 

Log in to LibreHealth EHR (admin/password) and search for the patient 'Maria Rodriguez'. Navigate to the Demographics section of her chart and find the HIPAA/Choices tab. 

Update her communication permissions to the following privacy settings:
1. Allow Voice Message: No
2. Allow Mail Message: No
3. Allow SMS: Yes

Save the changes to her record.
